capture_source: live capture 2026-11-12: the reference client (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50) logging on to an S/4HANA ABAP system as a user that does not exist, with two dummy passwords; both logons were refused (RFC_LOGON_FAILURE). Values are the 0x0117 records of the two logon frames.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. The passwords are dummies, never valid anywhere. The two logons, made from one process, carry the same seed.
